_doc: Bambu Lab ASA, printed, for analysis: stiffness and strength along the layers (x-y) and across them (z). Printed values vary with the printer, settings and spool: low and high are the data sheet's own spread either side; measure your own (the lever bench does) and record it as kind measured.
name: asa

modulus.source: Bambu Lab ASA technical data sheet V2.0 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040), as hosted by a reseller: https://www.additive-x.com/shop/mpattachments/file/viewonline/id/612/product_id/2399

poisson.rule: Poisson's ratio (Bambu publish none): an estimate for a printed amorphous plastic, as the kit takes PLA's (0.36) and PETG's (0.38)
poisson.source: An estimate of @rulecad/rules: no maker's data sheet gives one

density.source: Bambu Lab ASA technical data sheet V2.0 (ISO 1183)

softening.rule: Heat deflection temperature, ISO 75 at 0.45 MPa: where a part under a little load starts to creep
